drafted_from: tool row in tools/connected-drives/tool-rows.json, read-data/drives.mjs and test/drives.test.mjs
start_here: Say to your AI: "What is on my SAMPLE DRIVE, by kind of file, and which files are the biggest?" It runs tool:see-what-is-on-a-drive with mount /Volumes/SAMPLE DRIVE and hands back counts and bytes per kind.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list: it reads the drives this computer shows and changes nothing.
instructions: 1. Run tool:list-connected-drives and copy the mount of the drive to look at.
2. Say "What is on /Volumes/SAMPLE DRIVE?"; the AI calls tools:run for tool:see-what-is-on-a-drive with that mount.
3. Read kinds (kind, label, files, bytes; biggest first) and largest (path and bytes of the biggest files).
4. When complete is false the drive had more files than one run may read; the numbers cover what was read. Use tool:list-a-drive-folder to look into one folder.

worked_examples.title: See a small drive by kind
worked_examples.ask: What is on my SAMPLE DRIVE, by kind of file?
worked_examples.given: From tools/connected-drives/test/drives.test.mjs (tells what is on a drive by kind): the drive holds DCIM/clip-10.mov (2 bytes), DCIM/clip-9.mov (1 byte) and an empty hidden file DCIM/.hidden; a link that leads off the drive is not followed.
